distinct_texts.means: (opcode, width) -> [instances, distinct texts carrying it], each distinct program text counted once across every corpus

means: (opcode, width) -> instances, by DECODING every program in every committed Apple corpus. Read by g17isamap.corpus_sources so admission does not pay a 5M-instruction decode per regeneration; `g17vendorforms.py --check` re-decodes and compares, which is the difference between this index and the `spans` field it replaces. `distinct_texts` counts each distinct program text ONCE across both corpora: `union` counts records, and a text shipped in several libraries is one witness.
